changes.initial_review: Expose original cache decision as hit/denial/miss without duplicating the TLB lookup.
changes.counter_review: Public xtrn2phy calls core with FALSE: old denial FALSE and normal miss walk preserved. Cache-only follows same FAST_TLB/associative selection and dirty-write eligibility, returning before page walk on miss. Caller monitor_translate distinguishes negative denial from zero miss. This does not certify overall monitor fault handling.
changes.limits: Source and fixture inspection only; no fresh build/run or complete monitor/reentry proof.
changes.change_plan: Keep shared original translation core and tri-state cache query. Do not duplicate lookup or treat denied as miss; keep public BOOL wrapper. Review caller table prevalidation and accessed/dirty accounting in nt_inthk file audit.
changes.related_callers: monitor_translate; monitor_mark_access via original xtrn2phy; existing external translators; lin2phy cache population.
changes.verification_required: Existing cache-contract and duplicate-mapping fixtures cover hit/denial/miss, clean-write miss, stale TLB and ordinary external translation; preserve A/D, flush, read/write and supervisor/user controls when changing.
